concerns.text: The specification (FR‑009) requires a Sim‑to‑Real adapter or fine‑tuning protocol using real‑world videos, but no task in the list implements or validates such a protocol.
FR‑013 (precision and recall evaluation of the embedding‑to‑SymbolicState mapping) is absent from the task list; no task measures or reports these metrics against a ≥30‑task ground‑truth set.
FR‑016 (evaluate the Neural Policy using the deterministic Oracle) is not covered by any task; the pipeline only compares Symbolic vs. Neural outcomes, never Neural+Oracle.

FR‑017 (baseline GPU‑based compute metrics) is not realized by any concrete task; T012 runs the Neural Policy but does not record GPU cycles, memory, or wall‑clock time, and the optional Kaggle step is only mentioned in prose.
Task T014’s description references a non‑existent requirement FR‑018, creating a mismatch between the task list and the specification.

SC‑012 demands a demonstrated statistical power ≥ 0.80 for the McNemar test, yet T013’s verification only states “power is expected to be relatively high” without providing the calculated power value, making the claim unsubstantiated.
